findings.desc: CHK-001:happy:0 evidence command does not bind the intent literal: intent requires node -e filter matching /^test:.*-smoke$/ printing count=1 (only test:run-all-smokes-smoke); evidence runs python3 counting all test:* entries (returns 12). The evidence covers happy:1 (total test:* count), not happy:0 (smoke-specific count=1). The CHK-001:happy:0 intent — confirming exactly 1 test:*-smoke remains — has no valid evidence.

CHK-001:edge:2 intent command fails at runtime on the current manifest structure and the evidence substitutes a different command that does not verify the intent. Intent literal: node -e using Object.values(m) to iterate entries and check backing files, expected output ALL_MAPPED. Actual execution throws ORPHAN_MANIFEST because Object.values({$schema-doc, smokes}) returns the schema string + the smokes array, treating the schema string as an entry. The evidence instead runs python3 counting smokes array length (returns 139), which proves manifest count but not that every entry has a backing task file. The ALL_MAPPED check — that every manifest name has a corresponding .ts/.js task file — is unverified.

CHK-001:adversarial:0 evidence command does not bind the intent. Intent is: git diff main -- packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes.ts packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes-smoke.ts | wc -l (run-all-smokes runner files byte-identical). Evidence command is: python3 -c import json;json.load(open(packages/main/smoke-manifest.json)) (JSON parse check). The run-all-smokes.ts / run-all-smokes-smoke.ts byte-identical guard is covered by CHK-001:adversarial:1 evidence which correctly uses git diff, but CHK-001:adversarial:0 evidence covers a different check entirely (JSON parse of manifest) and misattributes it to the runner byte-identical intent.

CHK-001:adversarial:3, CHK-002:adversarial:1, CHK-003:adversarial:2: all three evidence entries claim git diff main -- scripts/verify-*.mjs | wc -l returns 0, but executing that command against the current branch returns 2167 (the branch has verify-*.mjs diffs relative to main). The evidence result=pass and note=Returns 0 are factually incorrect. The over-reach guard — that verify-*.mjs files are unmodified — cannot be confirmed; the branch has introduced changes in scripts/verify-*.mjs.

CHK-003:happy:1 evidence command covers only README.md but the intent literal covers docs/ README.md CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md. Evidence command: git grep -nE test:[a-z0-9-]+-smoke -- README.md. Intent command: git grep -nE test:[a-z0-9-]+-smoke -- docs/ README.md CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md (with keep-list filters). Executing the full intent command produces 47 lines of output from docs/requirements/decisions/*.md files containing removed test:X-smoke references. CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md were not checked by the evidence command. The intent — confirming no removed smoke refs in active tracked doc prose — is not covered.
